evals.name: page-is-live-before-the-first-question
evals.prompt: plan this: add a 'snooze until' option to the reminders drawer. The ticket has three Figma frames attached.
evals.expected_output: Before any question is asked, plan.html exists under .harness/<name>/, the viewer's URL (with its ?key= query string) has been printed, its hero is filled from the task, and — once the design scout returns — its #designs section shows every frame from design/INDEX.md open in a gallery with inline-designs.ts run. Every later section is still a spinner. The checkpoint question follows; plan.html is finished at step 7 in the same file, never a second one.
expectations: start-server.sh is invoked with --file pointing at .harness/<name>/plan.html before the first AskUserQuestion.
The printed URL keeps its ?key= query string.
The #designs section holds one .frame per row of design/INDEX.md, each with a data-img, a screen name and what it settles, and the IMG map is populated before the checkpoint.
Sections not yet written keep their SLOT: comments; none is padded with placeholder prose.
anti_expectations: Starts the server only at step 7, after the checkpoint
Presents only a file:// link, with no URL, while the server started successfully
Hides the frames inside closed <details> panels only, with no open gallery
Copies the shell a second time at step 7 instead of filling the file opened at step 1

evals.name: every-change-is-a-diff
evals.prompt: plan: rename the `owner` field on Invoice to `issuedBy` across the API, the store and the two React forms that write it.
evals.expected_output: Phase files whose steps show each change as a ```diff fence under a line naming the file and range — removed lines with -, added lines with +, a hunk header when line numbers are known — and a plan.html whose drill-down transcribes each as a pre.diff under a .snip-lbl.diff. Existing code appears only as - lines, or as a labelled pattern block when the step imitates it. verify-plan.ts exits 0.
expectations: Every step that changes a file carries a ```diff block, and the drill-down <li> carries the same lines inside <pre class="diff"><code>.
Each diff label names the file and the line range, e.g. src/models/invoice.ts:12-18.
A new file is a diff of + lines only.
verify-plan.ts reports no diff finding: every line opens with +, -, @@ or a space.
anti_expectations: Shows a 'before' block and an 'after' block for one change instead of a single diff
Describes a one-line edit in prose ('change owner to issuedBy on line 14') with no diff
Writes a diff line that opens with a character other than +, -, @@ or a space
Leaves an existing-code block with no label saying why it is on the page

evals.name: phases-lead-with-their-frames
evals.prompt: plan REF-4410: the new onboarding checklist card on the dashboard. Designs are on the ticket: desktop card, phone card, and the empty state.
evals.expected_output: In plan.html, each phase card opens with a .builds strip showing every frame that phase builds to, open, then the unlock box, then the drill-down. Every frame in design/INDEX.md appears in at least one phase's strip or is recorded 'not built' in plan.md. Each step that builds a screen also embeds its frame in a media panel.
expectations: Every .phase card that builds a surface has a .builds strip before its <details>, holding a .frame with data-img for each frame its steps name.
The strip's frames are open — not inside a <details>.
verify-plan.ts reports every INDEX frame embedded, or excused with the documented not-built form.
anti_expectations: Puts a phase's frames only at the bottom of a collapsed step panel
Names a frame in a step that the phase card's strip omits
Builds a phase to a screen with no frame while a frame for it sits in design/INDEX.md

evals.name: checkpoint-before-the-expensive-work
evals.prompt: how should we implement rate limiting on the public quotes endpoint?
evals.expected_output: A question loop that closes the open forks (window, key, store, response on limit), a fresh-context review of the draft solution, then one inline checkpoint summary — problem, approach, decisions with inferred ones flagged, risks, next — ending in a single Approve/Revise question. No phase file, test matrix or drill-down is written before that approval.
expectations: The checkpoint summary lists every decision as a D<n> line and flags each fork closed on the user's behalf as inferred.
The approve question is asked with AskUserQuestion and offers exactly Approve and Revise.
No phases/phase-N.md payload exists in plan.html before the approval.
anti_expectations: Writes phase files or the test matrix before the checkpoint is approved
Presents the recommended approach before listing the alternatives
Treats a 'Revise' answer as approval and continues to step 6

evals.name: auto-mode-defers-instead-of-asking
evals.prompt: --auto plan this: let a workspace owner export every invoice of a month as one CSV. Nothing in the ticket says which columns, the date format, or where the file goes.
evals.expected_output: A full plan with no AskUserQuestion call. Each fork the ticket leaves open — columns, date format, destination — is closed as an inferred decision, flagged inferred in the decisions table, and listed in plan.md's ## Deferred section marked auto. The checkpoint and the plan gate self-approve, and the step-8 summary names every auto-deferred fork.
expectations: No AskUserQuestion is issued at any step.
plan.md holds a ## Deferred section whose entries carry the word auto.
Every decision closed on the user's behalf is marked inferred in the decisions table and in the checkpoint summary.
The step-8 summary lists the auto-deferred forks by name.
anti_expectations: Asks a question despite --auto
Closes an open fork silently, with no inferred flag and no Deferred entry
Stops the run waiting for approval at the checkpoint or the plan gate

evals.name: same-decision-revised-twice-is-asked-about-directly
evals.prompt: plan the retry policy for the webhook sender. (Then, at the checkpoint, answer Revise twice, each time changing D2 — the backoff schedule — to a different value.)
evals.expected_output: After the second revision of D2 the skill stops re-presenting the whole summary and asks one direct question about D2 alone, with the options the two revisions named, before continuing. Each revision is re-presented and waits for approval; neither is treated as a confirmation.
expectations: After D2 is revised a second time, a single AskUserQuestion targets D2 by name.
Each Revise answer is followed by a re-presented summary showing what changed, and a fresh approval question.
design.md is recorded only after explicit approval.
anti_expectations: Integrates the second D2 revision and moves on without asking about D2 directly
Treats a Revise answer as approval
Dispatches the recorder before an Approve answer

evals.name: viewer-failure-never-blocks-the-plan
evals.prompt: plan: add a dark theme toggle to the settings page. (In this run, scripts/start-server.sh exits non-zero with a port error.)
evals.expected_output: Planning continues to the plan gate; plan.html is still written to .harness/<name>/plan.html and verified; the gate presents an absolute file:// path instead of a URL; the comment watcher is not armed. Nothing waits on the viewer.
expectations: plan.html exists and verify-plan.ts exits 0 at the gate.
The plan gate presents a file:// link to the absolute path of plan.html.
No comment-store.cjs wait is started when the server never came up.
anti_expectations: Retries the server in a loop or stops the run because the viewer failed
Presents a localhost URL that nothing serves
Skips writing or verifying plan.html because it cannot be viewed live

evals.name: atomic-route-cleans-up-the-viewer
evals.prompt: plan: the 'Export' button label on the invoices page should read 'Download PDF'.
evals.expected_output: Step 1 opens the page and starts the viewer as always; after the sweep the work is one obvious edit in one file, so the skill takes the atomic route: it stops the viewer with stop-server.sh, deletes the stub .harness/<name>/plan.html, and hands the step-1 findings to implement. No plan, no phases, no checkpoint.
expectations: stop-server.sh is called with the session dir from the step-1 startup JSON.
No .harness/<name>/plan.html remains on disk after the hand-off.
implement receives the step-1 findings (the file and line, the string to change).
anti_expectations: Leaves the viewer running after handing off
Leaves an all-spinner plan.html behind
Builds phases or asks a checkpoint question for a one-line label change

evals.name: page-comments-are-all-answered-before-re-presenting
evals.prompt: plan the bulk-archive action on the contacts list. (At the plan gate, leave three comments on the page: one question, one change request, one request the plan should refuse.)
evals.expected_output: The skill wakes on the batch, reads it with comment-store.cjs list, answers the question (status answered), makes the change in plan.html and the payload blocks (status changed), declines the third with a reason (status declined), re-arms the watcher, and only then re-presents the plan. On approval it kills the wait job, copies comments.json into .harness/<name>/, and stops the viewer.
expectations: Every one of the three threads receives a reply with a status of answered, changed or declined before the plan is presented again.
The changed thread's edit appears in both the HTML section and the matching payload block.
On approval, the backgrounded wait job is killed and .harness/<name>/comments.json exists.
anti_expectations: Re-presents the plan with a thread still unanswered
Changes the HTML but not the payload block, or the reverse
Leaves the wait job armed after approval
